features.feature: provider action receipts and saga recovery

missions.title: Repository truth map
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Inspect current main SHA, active routes, schemas, migrations, queue workers, deployment manifests, Vercel/Cloudflare/Fly/GCP and Supabase bindings; inventory all user-facing features against actual code. Preserve any working functionality. Produce docs/xroga/current-state.md with code evidence, owners, status = working/partial/placeholder/unverified, and a blocker register.
missions.acceptance: Run existing build, lint, unit and integration scripts when possible; store exact commands/results and never mark unexecuted tests passed.

missions.title: Source research reconciliation
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Read every supplied Xroga research attachment and the master research/candidate catalog. Compare all proposals to repo paths; build docs/xroga/requirements-ledger.md with each unique capability, source, status, priority, dependency, acceptance test, and repository candidates; reconcile duplicates instead of creating competing systems.
missions.acceptance: Every source heading and documented feature has a ledger entry; do not claim to have read inaccessible shared-chat content.

missions.title: Build-test and CI baseline
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Identify monorepo package managers, Node version, TypeScript builds, unit/e2e tests, skipped tests, migration scripts and CI definitions. Make existing CI deterministic; fix only proven baseline blockers and report any external-secret limitations.
missions.acceptance: Fresh checkout: frontend/backend build and unit suites reproducible, failures reported with exact commands.

missions.title: Deployment and dependency truth
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Audit actual deployed services, Dockerfiles, Cloudflare, Fly, Vercel, Cloud Run/Tasks/Jobs, Redis, Supabase, R2 and DNS as available. Document current state vs proposed infra; pin runtime and lockfile versions; identify secrets and live dependencies without exposing values.
missions.acceptance: Diagram maps current components and data flows with observed evidence; no destructive migration or secret rotation.

missions.title: Golden user journeys and acceptance fixtures
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Define reproducible browser/API fixtures for ordinary chat, web research, coding existing repo, build new SaaS, business read/write, mixed multi-outcome request, document creation, workflow, AI Employee, paid Android publishing, SEO and Drive. Use synthetic accounts/test tenants.
missions.acceptance: For each journey, document start state, exact assertions, expected evidence and truthful blocked/partial states; create runnable test skeletons.

missions.title: Code hygiene and operating contract
missions.phase_title: Truth, baseline and project governance
missions.implementation: Create or update AGENTS.md and docs/xroga/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md with rules: no duplicate orchestrator; scoped PR; branch first; current SHA; tests; no fake completion; redaction; permissions; cost cap; rollback; preserve unrelated code and historical decisions. Set a checklist template for all future Codex missions.
missions.acceptance: Codex or CI can run a small status/check script; shared instructions are short, versioned and executable.

missions.title: Tenant and RBAC security baseline
missions.phase_title: Authentication, authorization and tenant safety
missions.implementation: Audit Supabase Auth, access middleware, Row Level Security and service role use across projects, chats, files, connected accounts, browser sessions and costs. Implement missing server-side ownership enforcement without disrupting existing user accounts.
missions.acceptance: Cross-tenant read/write negative tests cover every high-value resource; avoid direct service-role data exposure.

missions.title: Canonical approval and authority contracts
missions.phase_title: Authentication, authorization and tenant safety
missions.implementation: Extend current authorization/approval gates into versioned outcome-scoped authority: identity, allowed target, action class, account, risk, spend limit, expiry, and revocation. Preserve existing prepared-action digest and single-use confirmations; prohibit approvals inferred from LLM text.
missions.acceptance: Sensitive send/delete/publish/spend require correct approval; stale/replayed digest and broadened permissions rejected.

missions.title: Credential vault and connected-account identities
missions.phase_title: Authentication, authorization and tenant safety
missions.implementation: Map current encrypted provider key store, OAuth callback policies, Composio account mapping and EAS store credentials; harden rotation, tenant scope, least privilege, logs and revocation. Avoid exposing provider secrets to LLM or client components.
missions.acceptance: Unit and integration tests for expired, swapped, revoked credentials and callback tampering; telemetry redacted.

missions.title: Tool/data egress and untrusted-input boundaries
missions.phase_title: Authentication, authorization and tenant safety
missions.implementation: Introduce or extend a decision hook for external writes/egress: data sensitivity, recipient, purpose, tool description trust, MCP/tool poisoning, SSRF, URL allowlists, browser uploads and prompt injection in retrieved documents. Use bounded policies and pre-execution checks.
missions.acceptance: Simulated exfiltration attempt, poisoned tool description and cross-account data flow are blocked with auditable reason.

missions.title: Account protection and audit logs
missions.phase_title: Authentication, authorization and tenant safety
missions.implementation: Audit sessions, password reset, login security, rate limiting, fraud/abuse and user-visible privacy controls; add immutable security audit references and retention policies. Avoid changing existing login methods without approval.
missions.acceptance: Unauthorized requests denied, audit entries created without leaking secrets, customer can revoke sessions/connections.

missions.title: Private R2/Xroga Drive correctness
missions.phase_title: Infrastructure, files and durable service delivery
missions.implementation: Repair backend/src/services/storage/projectFiles.ts and related R2 paths: durable uploads must not succeed via base64 data URLs or /tmp; private objects, tenant-key paths, quotas, content type, SHA-256 integrity, signed short-lived URLs, transactionally consistent metadata. Keep temporary previews separate.
missions.acceptance: Upload/download exact bytes after service restart; simulated R2 failure returns real error; cross-tenant access denied.

missions.title: Storage ledger, lifecycle and recovery
missions.phase_title: Infrastructure, files and durable service delivery
missions.implementation: Implement a distinct persistent user storage ledger separate from model token spend; object versions, reservations/release, abandoned multipart cleanup, garbage collection, soft-delete policies and optional backup/restore plan. Preserve existing user files.
missions.acceptance: Quota concurrency, stale reservation, tenant deletion and restore drills validated with synthetic objects.

missions.title: Production async runtime topology
missions.phase_title: Infrastructure, files and durable service delivery
missions.implementation: Based on actual deployment, reconcile API, BullMQ/Redis queues, Cloud Tasks/Jobs and Fly disposable sandboxes under one canonical task database. If migrating to Cloud Run, make changes additive with staging/rollback; avoid a second scheduler.
missions.acceptance: Task survives API restart; each dispatched job maps to one authoritative run ID, worker leases and bounded retries.

missions.title: Observability and SLO instrumentation
missions.phase_title: Infrastructure, files and durable service delivery
missions.implementation: Introduce or extend trace IDs spanning request → planner → queue → worker → provider/tool → evidence → response; collect actual latency, errors, cost and tenant-safe logs. Use existing logging first, add OpenTelemetry if useful.
missions.acceptance: Single synthetic run is traceable without secret leakage; API/job/UI have health and alert thresholds.

missions.title: Release-safe infrastructure operations
missions.phase_title: Infrastructure, files and durable service delivery
missions.implementation: Add reproducible dev/staging/prod configs, migration preflight, deployment canary, rollback steps, backup evidence, least-privilege CI identities, and disaster recovery runbooks for Supabase, R2, Redis and sandboxes.
missions.acceptance: Rollback drill and restore simulation documented and checked; no production mutation without explicit approval.

missions.title: Outcome Contract v2
missions.phase_title: Canonical execution, evidence and long-running task recovery
missions.implementation: Extend current ExecutableTaskNode and Universal Output Envelope, avoid replacement: lock objective, acceptance predicates, resources, permissions, budget, evidence requirements, delivery targets and version. Scope changes require user-approved amendment.
missions.acceptance: Serialization/migration tests; hidden changes to locked permissions or cost rejected.

missions.title: Task states and checkpoint resumption
missions.phase_title: Canonical execution, evidence and long-running task recovery
missions.implementation: Unify run states and reconcile backend/src/ai/runReconciler.ts with resumeTaskGraph; persistent checkpoints and worker leases. On restart, reconcile external side effects before retrying. Distinguish interrupted, recoverable, blocked and failed.
missions.acceptance: Kill worker mid-run; resume from checkpoint; no duplicate email/CRM/deploy writes.

missions.title: Dependency and resource concurrency
missions.phase_title: Canonical execution, evidence and long-running task recovery
missions.implementation: Extend taskGraphRunner resource locks beyond files to repository branch, provider account, CRM record, browser profile, budget allocation and deployment target; dynamic child tasks via approved graph versioning.
missions.acceptance: Parallel independent reads execute concurrently; conflicting writes serialize; per-tenant concurrency and rate limits pass.

missions.title: Verification, receipts and status honesty
missions.phase_title: Canonical execution, evidence and long-running task recovery
missions.implementation: Require postcondition verifiers for code tests, provider actions, browser changes, artifacts, deployments and storage. Add authoritative side-effect receipts and typed statuses; never infer finished from a model message or provider acceptance alone.
missions.acceptance: False-success fixtures fail; receipts and limitations render through existing Xroga Blocks; partial status accurate.

missions.title: Error taxonomy and deterministic recovery
missions.phase_title: Canonical execution, evidence and long-running task recovery
missions.implementation: Categorize provider timeouts, credential expiry, rate limits, build errors, policy blocks and ambiguous writes; implement safe retry vs compensating action vs manual action with idempotency. Version the recovery playbook.
missions.acceptance: Failure injection tests: retry-unsafe actions never duplicated; recovery reason traceable.

missions.title: User-intent relevance gate
missions.phase_title: Intent, relevance, app intelligence and multi-outcome compilation
missions.implementation: Improve native-first classification in semanticRequestPlanner: distinguish questions, examples, file analysis, research, build, real external actions, approval and explicitly unsupported operations. Do not suggest app connections for unrelated queries.
missions.acceptance: Intent suite covers 100+ positive/negative examples, including same-conversation shifts and ambiguous app requests; no false side effects.

missions.title: Multi-outcome goal decomposition
missions.phase_title: Intent, relevance, app intelligence and multi-outcome compilation
missions.implementation: Create higher-order Outcome Compiler above current mixed-write guard; split complex single prompt into typed child contracts with dependencies, scope, acceptance tests and costs. Preserve single-lane guard for risky combined writes.
missions.acceptance: Multi-app plus code prompt produces correct graph; every user-requested outcome accounted for; no invented extras.

missions.title: Capability binding and tool relevance
missions.phase_title: Intent, relevance, app intelligence and multi-outcome compilation
missions.implementation: Build a versioned capability-to-tool mapping on existing Composio and Xroga capability registry; evaluate native-first, app connected, auth requirements, risk, schemas, and task suitability; preloading only small relevant tool set.
missions.acceptance: Email explanation triggers no Gmail login; calendar retrieval selects only authorized calendar; unsupported tool reported honestly.

missions.title: Task Context Planner and project passport
missions.phase_title: Intent, relevance, app intelligence and multi-outcome compilation
missions.implementation: Create project-level facts, decision ledger, code map, relevant document retrieval, account identity, version and freshness checks. Build compact task context packets with source refs, ACL and token budget. Avoid global mixed-tenant memory.
missions.acceptance: Existing-repo task receives relevant files and tests; update remains within approved architecture; no private-memory leakage.
missions.upstream_candidates: ast-grep; Aider repo map; Graphiti benchmark later

missions.title: Model/provider routing and cost escalation
missions.phase_title: Intent, relevance, app intelligence and multi-outcome compilation
missions.implementation: Verify actual model IDs, provider health, endpoints, pricing and task capability; preserve current provider router/budget. Choose light suitable model, escalate on evidence of difficulty, track cost per verified success.
missions.acceptance: Offline provider fixtures plus live authorized probes; model unavailable falls back safely; no invented DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi costs.

missions.title: Composio account and tool certification
missions.phase_title: Business app integrations, workflows and task relevance
missions.implementation: Audit connected account sessions, multiple accounts per user, token expiration, provider metadata and 10+ high-value read/write actions. Extend current discover/prepare/execute without replacing Composio.
missions.acceptance: Account mapping prevents wrong Gmail/CRM destination; schemas versioned; read/write fixtures + safe live staging actions pass.

missions.title: Transactional business action execution
missions.phase_title: Business app integrations, workflows and task relevance
missions.implementation: Augment prepared business writes with resource locks, idempotency, provider receipts, authoritative follow-up reads and reconciliation on timeouts. Protect financial, destructive and external messaging actions with existing approvals.
missions.acceptance: Calendar/create, CRM/update, Gmail/send staged tests verify actual state; duplicate webhook/retry only one external action.

missions.title: Cross-app output typing and mapping
missions.phase_title: Business app integrations, workflows and task relevance
missions.implementation: Add typed mappings/transformations between tools and validation that distinguishes missing vs null vs stale vs ambiguous record IDs. Support safe read fanout then staged dependent writes.
missions.acceptance: Calendar → research → CRM → report golden journey passes with duplicates/ambiguous contact names.

missions.title: Native-first action and contextual connection UI
missions.phase_title: Business app integrations, workflows and task relevance
missions.implementation: Connect app requests only when necessary for the specific blocked child task; prefer user-provided file/native capability, and prioritize existing eligible authorized connection. Show inline app reason, account, permissions and Connect once needed.
missions.acceptance: Informational prompts never show connection bar; missing CRM pauses CRM only while research proceeds.

missions.title: Custom API and connector admission
missions.phase_title: Business app integrations, workflows and task relevance
missions.implementation: Add a gated route for verified provider OpenAPI specs when catalog lacks important function; typed schemas, auth choice, service limits, security and license vetting. No arbitrary third-party code execution or credential exposure.
missions.acceptance: Certified test API may execute read and approved write; malformed OpenAPI/unsafe URL rejected.

missions.title: Engineering worker registry
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Review Cline, engineeringRoles and softwareAgent; add a worker adapter/registry for native, Cline, ACP workers without spawning a competing orchestrator. Capabilities and per-run resources declarative.
missions.acceptance: One deterministic coding task works through existing Cline path and adapter; parity and rollback tests.

missions.title: Mini Worker for bounded edits
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Prototype a lightweight worker for small fixes, test generation and routine code changes with bounded tools and small context; compare against current Cline. Reject if no measured gain.
missions.acceptance: Five representative tasks match acceptance; cost/latency/quality recorded.

missions.title: Repository intelligence
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Add ast-grep function/symbol indexing, commit-keyed source maps and targeted context retrieval. Preserve Git history and branch semantics; avoid huge unbounded search dumps.
missions.acceptance: Multi-language query/cross-file fix uses correct symbols; improved context/token measurement.

missions.title: Genome admission and build composition
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Implement license/security/version provenance registry for certified starters, shadcn-style components and modules. Planner chooses reuse/adapt/compose/generate; avoid bulk arbitrary GitHub dependency installation.
missions.acceptance: Import one MIT starter, test build/license, parameterize safely, reject vulnerable/incompatible sample.
missions.upstream_candidates: Open SaaS; shadcn; Magic UI; OpenAPI

missions.title: Full-stack application golden slice
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Choose customer-requested SaaS app including React UI, Supabase auth+tables, API actions, roles and real user flow; build with tested assets, save durable files, create preview and push on branch.
missions.acceptance: Playwright performs create/read/update/delete protected records with two roles; tests pass across user refresh and sandbox restart.

missions.title: Existing-repository fix, Undo and delivery
missions.phase_title: Engineering, app builder, Genome and code worker excellence
missions.implementation: Improve app in existing GitHub repo: safe branch, small patch, tests, reviewer diff, source ownership, preview, PR, and atomic non-force Undo using actual starting HEAD; do not silently force push or destroy prior code.
missions.acceptance: Golden bug-fix task and Undo restore branch to intended state, preserve concurrent unrelated changes, reconcile deployment status.

missions.title: Browser worker contracts and action safety
missions.phase_title: Browser and desktop work with isolated AI Employees
missions.implementation: Build backend browser adapter using existing Playwright/sandbox infrastructure, deterministic first; Stagehand fallback for unknown UI; explicit task-scoped auth, page postconditions, safe URL boundaries, captcha/MFA handoff.
missions.acceptance: Authorized form workflow works; injection, unexpected redirects and unauthorized sites blocked.

missions.title: Separate employee browser sessions
missions.phase_title: Browser and desktop work with isolated AI Employees
missions.implementation: Allocate per-task authenticated browser contexts with separate cookies/storage and account bindings, tenant isolation, TTL, screenshots/video redaction, storage encryption and cleanup. Add remote account resource locks.
missions.acceptance: 3 concurrent employees isolated; no profile/session leakage or overlapping same-record mutation.

missions.title: Browser viewer and human takeover
missions.phase_title: Browser and desktop work with isolated AI Employees
missions.implementation: Convert current XrogaBrowser iframe-style viewing into real worker session observer, safe screenshot stream/control takeover, resumed tasks, user permission boundaries and accurate status. Do not imply iframe is computer-use runtime.
missions.acceptance: Frontend displays genuine worker steps; pause/takeover/resume works with protected identity; disconnect recovery.

missions.title: Desktop/computer-use evaluation gate
missions.phase_title: Browser and desktop work with isolated AI Employees
missions.implementation: Define controlled experimental worker for OS GUI tasks and OSWorld-style benchmarks, not unrestricted production access. Add explicit platform compatibility, isolation, files, privacy and high-risk action policies.
missions.acceptance: A few OS task fixtures in sandbox pass; default disabled until permission and reliability thresholds measured.

missions.title: Workflow definitions and typed compiler
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Replace Automations placeholder backend with persisted versioned workflow graph, triggers, branching, typed inputs/outputs, actions, validators, approvals and dry runs compiled to canonical task nodes.
missions.acceptance: API creates/reads/versions workflows; simulation nonmutating; invalid graph rejected.

missions.title: Schedule and event triggers
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Use BullMQ/Redis queue wakeups and Composio trigger subscriptions bound to actual user accounts; timezone, DST, overlap, idempotency, missed execution and pause/disable semantics.
missions.acceptance: One-time/daily/event tasks fire once despite duplicate events and restart; observed vs scheduled timestamps stored.

missions.title: AI Employee manifests and assignments
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Represent employees as tenant-scoped manifests, not always-on expensive bots: job skills, models, tool permissions, assigned workflow/tasks, browser session choice and cost cap. Integrate job queue and activity history.
missions.acceptance: Concurrent employees execute different roles, consume only active resources, cannot exceed scope; tenant tests.

missions.title: Certified Work Pack engine
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Create immutable installable Work Packs with capability contracts, user-specific installation, optional apps, settings, budgets, sandbox test and version upgrade gates. Native result before optional CRM; user does not juggle plugins.
missions.acceptance: Lead Research, SEO Audit, Website Guardian, QA certified packs run with real data; no unjustified connection prompts.

missions.title: Automations dashboard complete
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Implement Workflows, Scheduled Tasks, AI Employees, Work Packs, Run History UI in existing dashboard route. Use real APIs, app logos, permissions, settings and run receipts; no coming-soon simulation.
missions.acceptance: Playwright E2E install/activate/pause/schedule/monitor workflow; accessible mobile view.

missions.title: Workflow lifecycle, marketplace governance
missions.phase_title: Automations, Work Packs and AI Employees as real products
missions.implementation: Add soft-delete, installed-pack change management, logs, policy-safe outreach, creator trust boundaries, version compat, diff/approval for permission expansions and scheduled health checks. Reserve third-party marketplace as gated later.
missions.acceptance: Upgrade without permission broadening; cancel stops future jobs; audit log and pack validation preserved.

missions.title: Library dashboard and file ingestion
missions.phase_title: Xroga Drive, artifacts and multimodal capabilities
missions.implementation: Replace Library placeholder with My Files, Artifacts, Skills and Drive; browse/search/upload/download/preview/rename/delete + quotas. Use R2 metadata and Uppy only if needed; no simulated files.
missions.acceptance: Full-browser upload-refresh-download hash equality; authorized delete and cross-tenant protection.

missions.title: Document extraction and citation pipeline
missions.phase_title: Xroga Drive, artifacts and multimodal capabilities
missions.implementation: Add Docling and/or existing parser for PDF, DOCX, tables, image OCR when required, source offsets, structured extraction confidence, permission filtering and factual citations.
missions.acceptance: No model-invented values in scanned invoice; source-backed contract extraction and garbled scan warning.

missions.title: Spreadsheet/data intelligence worker
missions.phase_title: Xroga Drive, artifacts and multimodal capabilities
missions.implementation: Build robust CSV/XLSX formulas, SQL, data transformations, reconciliation, charts and downloadable artifact paths using deterministic libraries, not row-per-LLM inference.
missions.acceptance: 1000-row synthetic workbook totals/formulas correct; exported XLSX opens and cross-check passes.

missions.title: Document, slides and artifact Studio
missions.phase_title: Xroga Drive, artifacts and multimodal capabilities
missions.implementation: Integrate professional DOCX/PDF/PPTX editable deliverables, previews, export/versioning and evidence through existing Xroga Blocks and Xroga Drive. Keep document assets private; validate file structure visually.
missions.acceptance: Multi-page report, editable presentation and PDF generated, rendered, reopened and verified.

missions.title: Images, voice, video and media truth
missions.phase_title: Xroga Drive, artifacts and multimodal capabilities
missions.implementation: Audit current image, video, voice routes; remove false-enabled affordances, implement eligible providers/capability contracts, store media, show genuine preview, costs and editing actions only when backend supported.
missions.acceptance: Image/voice fixtures pass, disabled video honestly blocked; avoid silent no-op buttons and copyrighted asset leakage.

missions.title: Canonical live work and stream replay
missions.phase_title: Xroga frontend, response UX, real streaming and quality
missions.implementation: Harden existing terminal activity/reducer/SSE and xrogaEvent: show server-backed events only, persist sequence/replay across reconnect, no fake progress counters; preserve completed partial results.
missions.acceptance: Induced stalled network and reconnect show honest state, no duplicated tools/cards, first real event visible promptly.

missions.title: Rich results cards with verified data
missions.phase_title: Xroga frontend, response UX, real streaming and quality
missions.implementation: Extend xrogaBlocks/richResults with typed travel, hotels, restaurants, shopping, products, business, maps, citations, pricing basis/freshness and confirmation, while retaining source checks and existing renderer.
missions.acceptance: Price/booking status never invented; expired offers update; mobile responsive, keyboard + screen reader usable.

missions.title: Experience Genome design and accessibility
missions.phase_title: Xroga frontend, response UX, real streaming and quality
missions.implementation: Audit current design tokens, Lucide/Motion, responsive UI, rich states and multi-surface consistency; certify reusable patterns. Integrate Iconify only with per-set licensing; Storybook/axe/visual tests selectively.
missions.acceptance: Critical screens pass desktop/mobile/keyboard, reduced motion, loading/error/empty states; no regression.
missions.upstream_candidates: React Aria; Iconify; Storybook; axe-core; Argos

missions.title: Unified workspace and progressive disclosure
missions.phase_title: Xroga frontend, response UX, real streaming and quality
missions.implementation: Improve chat/workspace, code preview, source gallery, run graph, business action approval, session viewer and artifacts. Show advanced details only when relevant; preserve light native-first direct answers.
missions.acceptance: One prompt with 4 outcomes shows each real run, inline approval, artifacts and finish receipts; simple question shows no app widgets.

missions.title: Publish readiness and release manifest
missions.phase_title: Publish OS for Web, extensions, desktop and mobile
missions.implementation: Create real per-project, per-target compatibility checks, review requirements, target app ownership, version/package id, signing config, cost/approval. Distinguish connected/configured/buildable/submitted/live.
missions.acceptance: Web-only project never claimed native iOS; missing credentials listed precisely; target selection retained.

missions.title: Web and Chrome publish correctness
missions.phase_title: Publish OS for Web, extensions, desktop and mobile
missions.implementation: Improve Vercel/GitHub deployment and domain verification via user-owned access, resolve Chrome CWS v2 :fetchStatus URL, release receipts, listing states and rollback. Keep CWS first-listing dashboard gates honest.
missions.acceptance: Verified staging website URL and Chrome status sample; failed deploy not live; no force push.

missions.title: Android/iOS EAS release workflows
missions.phase_title: Publish OS for Web, extensions, desktop and mobile
missions.implementation: Upgrade SDK 52 scaffold, remove fixed com.xroga identity, preserve customer-owned package/bundle signing; build signed release, use EAS workflows and store test tracks, reconcile submission/review/live states. Real account prerequisites surfaced.
missions.acceptance: Verified AAB, emulator/device QA, internal track receipt and safe replay; Apple review not labeled live until confirmed.

missions.title: Desktop and broader marketplace adapters
missions.phase_title: Publish OS for Web, extensions, desktop and mobile
missions.implementation: Complete existing Electron packaging, code signing and notarization status; evaluate Tauri; add authorized Firefox/Edge publishing and Microsoft Store in separate adapters; license check; prioritize requested target only.
missions.acceptance: Signed installer/extension build fixture, backend release IDs, correct target status and rollback.

missions.title: Operations production health
missions.phase_title: Operations, growth, analytics and customer continuity
missions.implementation: Extend current Operations Centre to verified Vercel/Cloudflare, R2, Supabase, jobs, domains, TLS, error monitors and runtime logs; distinguish internal record writes from provider state.
missions.acceptance: Real staging probes and failure injection update provider receipts; no fake green status.

missions.title: Incident and Release Guardian
missions.phase_title: Operations, growth, analytics and customer continuity
missions.implementation: Add authorized incident investigation, regression checks, rollback proposals, deployment health and safe after-release alerts; manual approval for production changes and protected database actions.
missions.acceptance: Simulated outage alert correlates real failing endpoint; rollback works safely under approval.

missions.title: SEO technical worker and measurement
missions.phase_title: Operations, growth, analytics and customer continuity
missions.implementation: Extend Growth with Lighthouse/Unlighthouse, crawls, GSC analytics, provenance and source-backed SEO edits and post-change checks. Respect SEO quality; no thin spam pages or fabricated rankings.
missions.acceptance: Public site audit, real GSC permission handling, verified fix and report; GSC not required for basic public audit.

missions.title: Business growth and communications
missions.phase_title: Operations, growth, analytics and customer continuity
missions.implementation: Finish growthService non-in-app campaign path with approved email adapter and user-owned sender preference, lawful consent, suppression, receipts and delivery status. Complete campaigns/analytics/attribution reports without double counting.
missions.acceptance: Campaign dry run + safe sandbox send, unsubscribe/suppression and provider reconciliation pass.

missions.title: Budgets, quota and unit economics
missions.phase_title: Pricing, credits, payments and support readiness
missions.implementation: Audit Whop subscription, model budget reservation, storage quotas, sandbox usage, provider charges and allowed free/Pro entitlements; implement all-resource cost attribution and accurate per-verified-outcome accounting.
missions.acceptance: Concurrent task cannot overspend budget; UI aligns provider invoices/reconciliation and projected caps; no unverified pricing constants.

missions.title: Paid one-time publishing orders
missions.phase_title: Pricing, credits, payments and support readiness
missions.implementation: Use existing Whop webhook identity/dedupe for release orders; new idempotent one-time charge ledger distinct from subscription entitlements; quote, payment authorization, build, receipt and refund policy. Customer-owned store registration separately disclosed.
missions.acceptance: Duplicate payment webhook charges one release; payment unverified cannot start work; canceled/refunded order handled.

missions.title: Onboarding, notifications, support and controls
missions.phase_title: Pricing, credits, payments and support readiness
missions.implementation: Complete first-run experience, relevant examples, error explanation, notifications, connected account revocation, billing history, export/erase, help/feedback and support escalation. Optimize accessibility and low-friction use.
missions.acceptance: New user reaches one genuine successful task without tech setup; alerts not spammy; exports and support intake work.

missions.title: XrogaBench full evaluation program
missions.phase_title: Experience Engine, evaluations and Frontier intelligence
missions.implementation: Implement reproducible family tests for coding, multi-app, browser, data/documents, rich results, automation, mobile release, permissions, costs and recovery. Shadow-run candidate workers against existing baseline with representative tasks.
missions.acceptance: Run produces machine-readable success/cost/latency data; zero claims of benchmark wins without measurements.

missions.title: Experience Engine procedures and safe learning
missions.phase_title: Experience Engine, evaluations and Frontier intelligence
missions.implementation: Turn verified past executions into parameterized, tenant-sanitized recipes and recovery patterns; test across different inputs before registry admission, version/fork/rollback. No raw customer data in shared skills.
missions.acceptance: Repeated report/export task deterministically reuses certified procedure; changed provider schema invalidates safely.

missions.title: Founder-only Frontier research loop
missions.phase_title: Experience Engine, evaluations and Frontier intelligence
missions.implementation: Implement or complete private incremental discovery of GitHub, competitors, pain signals, providers and licenses with provenance, false-hype rejection and approval-required promotion; twice-monthly reports 1-15 and 16-end-month. Separate low-cost budget.
missions.acceptance: Founder-only ACL tested; report cites observed sources; promotion creates proposal/PR not auto deployment.
missions.upstream_candidates: Prior Frontier blueprint; repository intake catalog

missions.title: Cross-feature golden journeys
missions.phase_title: Full system acceptance, controlled rollout and handoff
missions.implementation: Execute all P00 journeys in staging with representative authorized test accounts; repair actual integration gaps across chat → plan → tool → task → verification → file → publish → resume. Include identity, payments, OAuth, file durability and cost.
missions.acceptance: All required journeys have signed evidence; failures remain open issues with owners; no cosmetic Done labels.

missions.title: Staged rollout, operator runbooks and handoff
missions.phase_title: Full system acceptance, controlled rollout and handoff
missions.implementation: Run migration dry runs and restore, canary deploy and rollback on explicit approval, traffic/feature flags, dashboards, alerts, support docs, project status ledger, follow-on backlog and ownership maps. Prohibit release if critical security/reliability gates fail.
missions.acceptance: Post-deploy smoke tests and monitored canary receipts; documents enable another developer to resume without conversational history.
